title: Structural insights of novel mutational frames in Bromodomain Containing-2 gene (BRD2) in juvenile myoclonic epilepsy: bed, bench, and laptop profiles.
authors: Kothapalli, Jyothinath; Prasad Uppu, Venkateswara; Munikumar, Manne; Kshirsagar, S V; Afshan Jabeen, Shaik; Sivanarayana, Gopalam
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BRD2基因突变在青少年肌阵挛癫痫中的分子对接与抗癫痫药物互作，虽涉及转录调控蛋白BRD2与药物结合，但非TF-DNA互作体系，且方法以临床测序和简单对接为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟深度建模。
abstract: PURPOSE: Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy (JME) is an adolescent onset type of idiopathic generalized epilepsies. Bromodomain containing protein-2 gene (BRD2), a transcriptional regulatory protein, has a susceptible role in the expression of JME. Considering the polymorphic variations observed in exon 3 of the BRD2 gene, we evaluated the molecular interactions with anti-seizure medication in individuals diagnosed with JME. METHODS: The genomic DNA was extracted from 5 mL of peripheral venous blood of JME participants (n = 55) and healthy control subjects (n = 55). Detailed anti-seizure medication and outcomes were noted during the study period. Identified novel mutations at nucleotide and protein sequences, compared by multiple sequence alignment. Wild-type (WT) and mutated-type (MT) structures were investigated for molecular docking and interactions with anti-seizure drugs. RESULTS: A common variant at c.1707G>A was found among 23 participants, while a single variant at c.1663ins C was found in one participant. The deletion positions were observed at c.1890delA, c.1892A>T, c.1895A>T, c.1896G>T, c.1897T>C, c.1898T>C, c.1899C>T, c.1900G>T, c.1901C>T and c.1902A>T exhibiting stop codon after p.111Pro>stop; these variants resulted in a truncated protein. In silico analysis was conducted to validate changes; docking analysis showed that novel variant has a significant role in the interactions with anti-seizure drugs. SIGNIFICANCE: Besides clinical and genetic outcomes,  approximately 5.45% unique genetical variations were observed in the participants. Significant mimicked at the binding site position (92-111) of human BRD2 ranges  approximately 8.2%,  approximately 16.4%, and  approximately 10.6%. Further, research is needed to identify the importance of polymorphism alterations at the binding site and their molecular interactions with anti-seizure drugs, which might be confirmed in a diverse population with JME.
abstract_zh: 目的：青少年肌阵挛癫痫（JME）是一种青少年期发病的特发性全面性癫痫类型。含溴结构域蛋白-2基因（BRD2）作为一种转录调控蛋白，在JME的表达中具有易感作用。鉴于BRD2基因外显子3中观察到的多态性变异，我们评估了诊断为JME的个体中与抗癫痫药物的分子相互作用。方法：从JME参与者（n = 55）和健康对照受试者（n = 55）的5 mL外周静脉血中提取基因组DNA。研究期间详细记录了抗癫痫药物及其结局。通过多序列比对，鉴定了核苷酸和蛋白质序列上的新突变。对野生型（WT）和突变型（MT）结构进行了分子对接及其与抗癫痫药物相互作用的调查。结果：在23名参与者中发现了一个常见变异c.1707G>A，而在1名参与者中发现了单一变异c.1663ins C。缺失位置在c.1890delA、c.1892A>T、c.1895A>T、c.1896G>T、c.1897T>C、c.1898T>C、c.1899C>T、c.1900G>T、c.1901C>T和c.1902A>T处观察到，在p.111Pro>stop后出现终止密码子；这些变异导致蛋白质截短。进行了计算机模拟分析以验证变化；对接分析显示，新变异在与抗癫痫药物的相互作用中具有显著作用。意义：除了临床和遗传结局外，在参与者中观察到约5.45%的独特遗传变异。在人类BRD2的结合位点位置（92-111）处，显著模拟范围约为8.2%、约16.4%和约10.6%。需要进一步研究以确定结合位点多态性改变的重要性及其与抗癫痫药物的分子相互作用，这可能在多样化的JME人群中得到证实。
